split: Custom pooled dev/eval, uploader and exact/normalized-PCM duplicate groups, deterministic 5-fold outer test and 4-fold inner validation; not the official FSD50K split
short_audio: Right-pad only clips shorter than one window with zeros; omit incomplete final windows of longer clips
selection: Maximize validation clip recall subject to precision>=0.90 and FPR<=0.02; then F1, smaller FPR and larger hop. If infeasible disclose fallback, never claim deployment readiness.
test_policy: Fit scaling on train only; select model, checkpoint, threshold and hop on validation only; save selection before computing a single locked test report. No optimization after inspecting test errors.
latency_policy: Measure actual CPU inference separately. File-start-to-first-positive is not event-onset latency; no precise event timestamps or hardware microphone latency are available.
